review_scope: All 49 full-frame tiles; fixed initial-site crops and NCC. No automatic physical instance count.
initial_cup_site: Recognizable blue cup remains stationary throughout the generated clip.
moving_foreground: Additional blue shape responds near the arm in early frames, then deforms into a narrow fragment; original cartoon identity is not preserved reliably.
image_quality: Room, table, brown cup and robot remain recognizable; generated detail is softer than real.
temporal_consistency: Global background is stable; moving shape and robot interaction remain physically implausible.
trajectory_and_identity: Removal of persistent reference alone does not transfer the original object. NCC measures stationary texture, not identity of moving shape.
